articles.headline: Premier League live updates: Arsenal lead at Sunderland after Raya penalty save
articles.description: Our final game of the day: defending champs Arsenal are looking for another win, this time at Sunderland. Elsewhere, Tottenham's winless streak in the Premier League continued with a 0-0 draw vs. Everton, and Hull City drew Chelsea on a busy Saturday.

articles.headline: Winless Tottenham lack confidence and physical conditioning - Roberto De Zerbi
articles.description: Roberto de Zerbi has admitted Tottenham lack "physical condition" and "confidence" but insisted they can overcome their slow start to the season.

articles.headline: Winless Tottenham still searching for first goal of season after draw with Everton
articles.description: Tottenham Hotspur fired another blank after being frustrated by Everton in a 0-0 draw to extend their winless start to the new Premier League season to four matches.

articles.headline: Andoni Iraola cites 'lack of freshness' after Liverpool's draw with Fulham
articles.description: Liverpool manager Andoni Iraola said his players were tired but refused to use it as an excuse after being held to a 0-0 draw by Fulham at Anfield.

articles.headline: Hull continue unbeaten Premier League streak with entertaining 2-2 draw at Chelsea
articles.description: Hull continued their unbeaten start to the Premier League season after an entertaining 2-2 draw at Chelsea.

articles.headline: Xabi Alonso wants more 'boring' wins as Chelsea draw with Hull
articles.description: Xabi Alonso says his Chelsea side must show more desire in defence, and warns it will take time to fix their frailties at the back after they drew 2-2 with Hull City at Stamford Bridge on Saturday.

articles.headline: Nottingham Forest's late winner deepens Aston Villa's new season woe
articles.description: Igor Jesus piled the misery on Aston Villa as his late goal snatched a 2-1 victory for Nottingham Forest at Villa Park.

articles.headline: Chelsea draw with Premier League surprise package Hull City
articles.description: Chelsea's chaotic start to life under Xabi Alonso continued with an entertaining 2-2 draw against Hull at Stamford Bridge.

articles.headline: In-form Hull show why Chelsea fans are in for a rough ride this season
articles.description: Chelsea have a star-studded attack which has saved them many times already this season, but their defense was exposed again vs. an impressive Hull City.

articles.headline: Liverpool momentum dented by Anfield draw with struggling Fulham
articles.description: Fulham frustrated Liverpool to claim their first point of the season with a goalless draw at Anfield on Saturday.

articles.headline: Kevin Schade brace denies Bournemouth a first Premier League win of season
articles.description: Bournemouth boss Marco Rose was denied a first Premier League win after a calamitous goalkeeping mistake allowed Brentford to claim a 2-2 draw.

articles.headline: Ipswich's impressive start continues with win over 10-man Crystal Palace
articles.description: Zian Flemming's first goal for Ipswich snatched a dramatic 3-2 victory at 10-man Crystal Palace for their second Premier League win of the season.

articles.headline: Liverpool ratings: Barcola, Wirtz, Gravenberch struggle in Fulham draw
articles.description: Liverpool were held to a 0-0 draw with struggling Fulham at Anfield, as a host of top players failed to perform.

articles.headline: Blackburn see off Millwall
articles.description: Dapo Afolayan's brace helped Blackburn secure a much-needed 3-1 win over Millwall at a discontented Ewood Park.

articles.headline: Resurgent Stoke win at Watford
articles.description: Jack McGlynn orchestrated Stoke's first away win since January with a deserved 2-1 success at Watford.

articles.headline: Transfer rumors, news: Liverpool look at Inter's Stankovic
articles.description: Liverpool remain keen on Internazionale midfielder Aleksandar Stankovic after enquiring about him while negotiating Curtis Jones' €35 million move to San Siro. Transfer Talk has the latest.

articles.headline: Late Ipswich comeback sinks 10-man Palace
articles.description: Ipswich came from behind to secure their first Premier League away win since April 2025 after beating 10-man Crystal Palace 3-2.

articles.headline: Liverpool held at Anfield as Fulham pick up first point
articles.description: Liverpool were held to a frustrating goalless draw as Fulham picked up their first point of the Premier League season at Anfield.

articles.headline: Glasner haunts Emery again as Forest win at Aston Villa
articles.description: Nottingham Forest beat Aston Villa 2-1 at Villa Park to leave Unai Emery's side still searching for their first Premier League victory of the season.

articles.headline: Poor Chelsea defending sees Hull remain unbeaten in Stamford Bridge draw
articles.description: Hull continued their unbeaten start in the Premier League as they capitalised on some poor Chelsea defending to draw 2-2 at Stamford Bridge.

articles.headline: Xabi Alonso on Chelsea's João Pedro: Like Karim Benzema, as good as Erling Haaland
articles.description: Chelsea boss Xabi Alonso has compared striker João Pedro to the like of Erling Haaland and Karim Benzema following his flying start to the Premier League this season.

articles.headline: Dalot still dreams of putting Manchester United back on top
articles.description: After eight years at Old Trafford, Diogo Dalot still has the desire to win the biggest trophies with Manchester United as another crucial derby looms.

articles.description: Tottenham Hotspur boss Roberto De Zerbi has called new arrival Mykhailo Mudryk's injury "stupid" and has backed the winger to return to action soon.

articles.headline: Monaco's Lamine Camara says he has 'turned the page' after failed Chelsea move
articles.description: Monaco midfielder Lamine Camara said he has moved on from his collapsed move to Chelsea and is fully focused on playing well for the Ligue 1 leaders.

articles.description: Chelsea boss Xabi Alonso has said he believes the close friendship between Cole Palmer and summer signing Morgan Rogers is helping accelerate their blossoming on-field partnership.
